#### `stc.relics.docker.guards.enable`

Whether to enable warnings for containers that publish on every interface or mount the raw Docker socket.

- **Type:** boolean
- **Valeur par défaut:** `false`
- **Exemple:** `true`
- **Déclarée dans:** [`relics/nixos/docker/guards.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/docker/guards.nix)
